title: FIPS operational risk: stub mode registers is_fips=1 but gate always returns 0
description: In wolfssl_provider.c, the wolfssl_provider struct sets is_fips=1 unconditionally. In stub mode (CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT not defined), wolfssl_fips_gate() always returns 0 (lines 38-40). This means: (1) the stub provider registers as a FIPS provider and increments fips_provider_count, enabling FIPS enforcement that hides all non-FIPS providers, (2) every fips_gate() call returns 0-operational even though no actual wolfCrypt FIPS module is present, (3) userspace CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_STATUS returns FIPS_OPERATIONAL when the system is providing no real cryptographic security. A misconfigured build (missing wolfcrypt headers, CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT=0) silently presents as FIPS-operational. The pr_warn at module_init is the only protection — it is insufficient because it does not prevent registration.
close_reason: fixed: wolfssl_provider.c now sets .is_fips=1 only under #ifdef CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT, .is_fips=0 in stub mode
